title: 12 Best Drift through the tranquil Kerala backwaters on a traditional kettuvallam rice barge converted into a floating guesthouse near Kochi.
description: Discover the top 12 kettuvallam houseboats near Kochi for an unforgettable Kerala backwater experience. Find luxury, budget-friendly, and authentic floating guesthouses.
